confidence_notes: Food estimates use sparse [Numbeo data](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Interlaken-Switzerland), with the latest survey update after July. Cocktail and wine estimates use [local bar guidance](https://www.interlaken-trip.com/guides/interlaken-nightlife-guide/) and their relationship to beer prices. July accommodation figures are high-season model estimates with substantial uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Swiss Alpine tourist towns such as Grindelwald provide a regional basis, adjusted for Interlaken's summer demand and high Swiss cost level.
